Grapes.why: The Southwest's Mediterranean climate is ideal for premium wine grape production.
Grapes.irrigation_system: Drip irrigation to control vine growth and fruit quality.
Grapes.grazing: Sheep grazing during dormancy helps manage weeds.
Grapes.suitability: Excellent for viticulture; supports local wine industry.

Tomatoes.why: Tomatoes benefit from the mild temperatures and fertile soils.
Tomatoes.irrigation_system: Drip irrigation to prevent foliar diseases.
Tomatoes.suitability: Horticultural crop with high market demand.

Lettuce.why: Lettuce grows well in the cool seasons of the Southwest.
Lettuce.irrigation_system: Sprinkler or drip irrigation to maintain moisture.

Carrots.why: Carrots prefer the deep, well-drained soils of the region.
Carrots.irrigation_system: Sprinkler irrigation to ensure even soil moisture.
Carrots.suitability: Horticultural crop; good for crop rotation.

Broccoli.why: Broccoli thrives in cooler temperatures found in the Southwest.
Broccoli.irrigation_system: Overhead or drip irrigation to maintain consistent moisture.

Apples.why: Cool winters and mild summers favor apple production.
Apples.grazing: Sheep grazing can be utilized in orchards.

Pears.why: Pears require chilling periods provided by the region's climate.
Pears.irrigation_system: Drip irrigation to prevent water stress.

Berries.why: The Southwest's climate is suitable for various berries like strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries.

Dairy Pasture.why: Lush pastures support dairy farming due to reliable rainfall.
Dairy Pasture.irrigation_system: Sprinkler or pivot irrigation to maintain pasture quality.

Sustainable Grazing.why: Enhances pasture longevity and soil health.
Sustainable Grazing.irrigation_system: Depends on pasture species and rainfall.

Horticulture Best Practices.why: Implementing best practices increases crop yield and quality.
Horticulture Best Practices.irrigation_system: Efficient systems like drip irrigation are recommended.
